clips.title: The story
paras: Return to Jitters concludes Chef Grual's culinary errand in Duskwood. Having prepared his infamous 'crab' cakes using the gooey legs of the local venom web spiders, Grual sends you back to the starving, terrified hermit at Raven Hill. Delivering the meal finally satisfies Jitters' desperate hunger.

Duskwood is short on conventional livestock and sea life, leaving Chef Grual at the Scarlet Raven Tavern to improvise with whatever the blighted forest provides. His renowned 'Dusky Crab Cakes' contain no actual crab meat at all, relying instead on gooey legs harvested from the venom web spiders creeping through the wood. Grual considers this resourceful cooking; anyone with a delicate stomach might view it with horror.

Jitters spends his days huddled at Raven Hill, utterly consumed by fright and paralyzed by whatever horrors drove him out of the woods. Weak with terror and unable to muster the courage to hunt or forage for himself, his empty stomach only amplifies his distress. Receiving the warm cakes brings a rare moment of relief to the trembling vagrant, who is far too hungry to question what kind of 'crab' Chef Grual used.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: And here we are - "Crab" Cakes ala Grual!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Aha! Thank you, friend. Those really hit the spot!
And here, please let me pay you for these!
